source.author: verg
source.text: Non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea vox, omnis scelerum comprendere formas, omnia poenarum percurrere nomina possim.
source.text_original: Non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, / ferrea vox, omnis scelerum comprendere formas, / omnia poenarum percurrere nomina possim.'
source.text_english: No, even if I had a hundred tongues, a hundred mouths, and a voice of iron, I could not comprehend all the forms of crimes, nor run through all the names of punishments.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea uox, omnia morborum percurrere nomina possim, quae Fabiola in tanta miserorum refrigeria commutauit, ut multi pauperum sani languentibus inuiderent.
reuse.text_original: non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea uox, omnia morborum percurrere nomina possim, quae Fabiola in tanta miserorum refrigeria commutauit, ut multi pauperum sani languentibus inuiderent.
reuse.text_english: No, if I had a hundred tongues and a hundred mouths, a voice of iron, I could not run through all the names of the diseases that Fabiola transformed into such great comforts for the wretched, so that many of the poor, though healthy, would envy those who were ailing.
